pausa.lead: Some days simply don't count — a trip, an illness, life. While a pause lasts, the streak stays exactly as it was: it doesn't grow and it stays safe.
pausa.reglas: You can declare up to {tope} pauses per calendar year, each up to {max} days long. If you couldn't declare it in time, you can cover up to {ventana} days back from the last day of practice.
pausa.estado.vigente: There is a pause declared until {fecha}.
pausa.estado.sin: There is no pause declared right now.
pausa.exito: Pause declared. The streak stays as it was.
pausa.error.rango_invertido: The pause ends before it starts. Check the dates.
pausa.error.pausa_demasiado_larga: A pause can last up to {max} days. Declare a shorter stretch; you can declare another one after.
pausa.error.tope_anual: The {tope} pauses of {anio} have already been declared. The counter resets on January 1st; the streak keeps counting as usual.
pausa.error.fuera_de_la_ventana: You can cover up to {ventana} days back from the last day of practice. The new streak counts from the next day of practice.
pausa.error.sin_dia_que_reparar: There is no day of practice yet, so there is nothing to cover going back.
pausa.error.fecha_invalida: Check the dates: a first day and a last day are needed.
pausa.error.sin_permiso: That profile doesn't belong to this account.
pausa.error.generico: The pause couldn't be declared. Please try again.
